headline: Last session: Sensex jumped 897 points while Nifty surged to 25,800 driven by strong market rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: On the last trading day (Nov 20), Sensex rallied 897 points and Nifty reached 25,800.
The Indian Rupee recorded its largest single-day gain in a month during the last session.
Core sector output grew strongly, touching a 31-month high of 10.9% in October.
Foreign exchange reserves registered a drop of $14.2 billion to $705.34 billion.
whatHappening: IndusInd Bank invoked clawback provisions against Romesh Kathpalia dating back to 2020.
India's core sector growth surged to 10.9% in October, marking a multi-month high.
India's forex reserves dropped by $14.2 billion to $705.34 billion.
Delhi-NCR is expected to drive a major portion of India's Rs 7.5 lakh crore wedding season expenditure.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices closed sharply higher with Sensex gaining 897 points and Nifty reaching 25,800. Macroeconomic data provided support as India's core sector growth accelerated to a 31-month high of 10.9% in October. Individually, IndusInd Bank made headlines after invoking clawback provisions against Kathpalia from 2020.
